title: kv-cache: adaptive eviction + fragmentation-aware compaction + paging/spillover improvements
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: Ongoing production incidents and perf runs showed pathological KV-cache fragmentation and memory pressure during mixed-length workloads (long-context chat + short inference). Existing LRU-based eviction and naive spillover to host memory caused frequent tail-latency spikes and OOMs when many large keys were pinned in GPU memory. This PR implements an adaptive eviction and compaction system that reduces fragmentation, prioritizes paging/spillover for low-value entries, and cooperates with the runtime scheduler to avoid compaction during high latency-critical load.

Summary of changes: Added a fragmentation-aware eviction heuristic (EvictionScore combines recency, size, fragmentation-cost, and a workload-priority multiplier). Introduced background compaction that coalesces fragmented KV entries into contiguous regions and opportunistically frees GPU memory. Implemented async paging/spillover paths to host memory with prioritized queues so high-priority customer requests avoid blocking. Integrated eviction signals with the scheduler so compaction/paging is deferred when latency SLOs are at risk. Exposed runtime knobs (kv.eviction.threshold, kv.compaction.parallelism, kv.spillover.target) and added detailed metrics and tracing for eviction/compaction events.

Compatibility & safety: All changes are feature-flag gated behind kv.adaptive_eviction_v2 and enabled by default on Dedicated beta only. Behavior falls back to previous LRU eviction when the feature flag is disabled or if paging is not available. Thread-safety: careful refcounts and a new KVShardLock implementation to avoid races during compaction.

Testing & results: Unit tests for eviction scoring, compaction correctness, and paging fallbacks. Integration tests in perf-canary that exercise mixed workloads. Perf numbers from 48-hour canary: OOM events down 95% vs baseline; 99th percentile latency reduced ~18% for mixed workloads; throughput impact negligible (<1%) when compaction runs in background.

How to review: Focus on the eviction scoring math (runtime/kv_cache/evict_policy.cpp), compaction correctness (runtime/kv_cache/compactor.cpp), and scheduler integration (runtime/scheduler/compaction_coordinator.cpp). The metric names are stable; verify the new trace spans and histogram labels.

Notes: This is a performance-sensitive change; rolling to production should follow the existing canary -> staged rollout path. Related: ENG-8273, ENG-8301.

review_comments: Jordan Kim (reviewer): Can you justify the chosen weights in EvictionScore? How sensitive are perf numbers to those constants? Also please add metrics for compaction CPU/IO usage.

Ava Martinez (author): Added a short appendix to docs and a test that sweeps weights in small increments; results are in perf-canary runs. Added kv.compaction.cpu_seconds and kv.spillover.io_bytes metrics in runtime/metrics/kv_metrics.cpp.
Priya Desai (reviewer): Thread-safety looks good overall but I flagged a potential race where evict + compaction could both update the same entry refcount. Can you add an assertion and a unit test?
Ava Martinez (author): Added unit test (tests/kv/refcount_race_test.cc) and assertion; switched to ScopedShardLock and added explanatory comment. Re-run CI.
Luca Rossi (reviewer): Request: expose an operator-visible stat for number of pages currently paged out per model to help SRE debugging.
Ava Martinez (author): Exposed kv.paged_pages_per_model histogram and documented the metric in docs/operations/kv_eviction.md.
merge_summary: Merged by Ava Martinez via squash and merge. Squash title: 'kv-cache: adaptive eviction + compaction + paging/spillover improvements' - includes tests, docs, and perf updates. Rollout: gated behind kv.adaptive_eviction_v2; enabled in Dedicated beta for staged canary.
release_notes:
- Add adaptive eviction (fragmentation-aware) to KV cache; reduces OOMs and tail latency for mixed workloads.
- Background compaction that coalesces fragmented KV entries to free GPU memory.
- Async paging/spillover to host memory with prioritized queues.
- New runtime knobs: kv.eviction.threshold, kv.compaction.parallelism, kv.spillover.target.
- New metrics: kv.compaction.cpu_seconds, kv.spillover.io_bytes, kv.paged_pages_per_model.
